# Flipper Zero Documentation

## Docs

- [125 kHz RFID](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/rfid.md): 125 kHz RFID module's functionality and hardware
- [iButton](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/ibutton.md): iButton module's functionality and hardware
- [Adding 125 kHz cards manually](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/rfid/add-manually.md): Learn how to add manually and edit 125 kHz RFID card data
- [Flipper Zero Documentation](https://docs.flipper.net/zero.md): Discover user guides, developer documentation, schematics, blueprints, and more
- [Controls](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/basics/control.md): Learn how to control your Flipper Zero
- [Settings](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/basics/settings.md): Learn about Flipper Zero settings
- [Reboot](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/basics/reboot.md): Learn how to reboot your Flipper Zero normally, perform a hard reboot, or reboot to recovery mode
- [Sub-GHz](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/sub-ghz.md): Sub-GHz module's functionality and hardware
- [Animal microchips](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/rfid/animal-microchips.md): Learn how to locate and read animal microchips as well as find information about the animal in online pet recovery services
- [Writing data to T5577 cards](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/rfid/write-data.md): Learn how to write data to T5577 blanks with your Flipper Zero
- [Reading 125 kHz RFID cards](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/rfid/read.md): Learn how to read, save, and emulate 125 kHz RFID cards
- [Infrared](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/infrared.md): Infrared module's functionality and hardware
- [Using universal remotes](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/infrared/universal-remotes.md): Learn about the types of universal IR remotes Flipper Zero has and their commands
- [Adding iButton keys manually](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/ibutton/add-manually.md): Find instructions on how to create a virtual version of an iButton key and emulate it using your Flipper Zero
- [Troubleshooting apps](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/apps/troubleshoot.md): Learn about common Flipper Zero app errors and ways to resolve them
- [Troubleshooting drivers on Windows](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/qflipper/windows-debug.md): Learn how to make sure that your Windows computer is configured correctly to update your Flipper Zero via qFlipper
- [Tech specs of Flipper Zero](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/development/hardware/tech-specs.md): Take a closer look at the tech specs of your Flipper Zero and explore its hardware capabilities
- [Quick start guide](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/video-game-module/quick-start.md): Learn how to install the Video Game Module and connect it to your TV
- [Development](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/development.md)
- [Reading signals](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/sub-ghz/read.md): Reading and sending procedures and configurations of the Read function
- [Desktop](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/basics/desktop.md): Learn about the Desktop, status bar indicators, and what menus and apps you can access from there
- [Remotes in Flipper Mobile App](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/infrared/remotes-mobile.md): Learn how infrared remotes in Flipper Mobile App work and what devices you can control. You’ll also learn how to find the right remote for your device and send signals using your phone
- [Apps](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/apps.md): Learn more about the collection of community-developed apps for Flipper Zero, as well as how to manage them
- [External modules blueprints](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/development/hardware/modules-blueprints.md): Drawings and 3D models of external modules
- [Power](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/basics/power.md): Learn how to power on, power off, and charge your Flipper Zero, as well as power modes and tips to maximize battery performance
- [Internal storage repair](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/basics/firmware-update/storage-repair.md): Learn how to back up your Flipper Zero, reset it to the factory settings, and restore it from a backup
- [HID controllers](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/apps/controllers.md): Learn how to remotely control presentations, emulate a keyboard, control media players on your computer, emulate a mouse, and more
- [ST-Link V3 Developer Board](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/development/hardware/devboard-stlinkv3.md): Find the main specifications of the ST-Link V3 Developer Board, its schematics, and a link to the Altium Designer project
- [Firmware update](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/video-game-module/firmware-update.md): Learn how to update Video Game Module firmware via Flipper Zero
- [Frequencies](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/sub-ghz/frequencies.md): The list of regions and frequencies allowed for civilian use
- [Bad USB](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/bad-usb.md): Learn about how BadUSB devices work and how to turn your Flipper Zero into one
- [Video Game Module](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/video-game-module.md): Meet the Video Game Module for Flipper Zero! Learn about the module's main features, buttons, and connectors
- [First start](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/basics/first-start.md): Learn how to power on and reboot your Flipper Zero, insert a microSD card, and update the firmware
- [Unlocking cards with passwords](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/nfc/unlock-with-password.md): Learn how to capture the password sent by the reader, generate passwords for supported types of cards, and unlock cards by entering passwords manually
- [Blueprints of Video Game Module](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/development/hardware/vgm-blueprints.md)
- [Сustom firmware](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/video-game-module/custom-firmware.md): Learn how to install custom firmware on the Video Game Module via Flipper Zero and PC
- [Schematics of Flipper Zero](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/development/hardware/schematic.md): Electronic schematics of all Flipper Zero PCBs
- [Wi-Fi Developer Board schematics](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/development/hardware/devboard-schematics.md): Electronic schematics of the Wi-Fi debugger module.
- [Firmware recovery](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/basics/firmware-update/firmware-recovery.md): Learn how to repair the firmware of your Flipper Zero
- [Contributing to Flipper Docs](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/contribute.md): You’ll learn the steps for contributing to Flipper Docs
- [GPIO & modules](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/gpio-and-modules.md): GPIO function description, pinout, and electric requirements
- [Hardware](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/development/hardware.md)
- [Reading infrared signals](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/infrared/read.md): Learn how to read, save, and emulate infrared signals with your Flipper Zero
- [Recovering MIFARE Classic keys](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/nfc/mfkey32.md): Learn how to conduct the MFKey32 attack, both with and without physical access to the card, as well as card-only attacks for which you don’t need access to the reader to calculate the keys
- [Writing data to magic cards](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/nfc/magic-cards.md): Learn how to write the UID and data from an original card to an NFC magic card
- [Reporting Mobile App bugs](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/mobile-app/bug-report.md): Learn how to submit a bug report via the mobile application and forum
- [MicroSD card setup](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/basics/sd-card.md): Learn how to insert, format, and safely remove a microSD card
- [Writing data to iButton keys](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/ibutton/write.md): Learn about compatible blanks and keys and how to write data to them with Flipper Zero
- [Flipper Mobile App](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/mobile-app.md): Main functionality of the Flipper Mobile App. Flipper Zero connection and update procedures
- [U2F (Universal 2nd Factor)](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/u2f.md): Main functionality of the U2F (Universal 2nd Factor) application
- [Supported Sub-GHz vendors](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/sub-ghz/supported-vendors.md): The list of supported vendors and devices
- [Command-line interface](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/development/cli.md): Learn how to access the Flipper Zero CLI, view available commands, view logs, and chat with other Flipper Zero owners via sub-1 GHz radio
- [GPIO on Video Game Module](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/video-game-module/gpio.md): Find pinouts, drawings, schematics for the Video Game Module
- [Adding new remotes](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/sub-ghz/add-new-remote.md): Creation of a virtual remote and pairing with a receiver
- [Reading iButton keys](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/ibutton/read.md): Detailed instructions on how to read, save, edit, and emulate keys using your Flipper Zero, as well as troubleshooting common problems
- [qFlipper](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/qflipper.md): Learn about the main functionality of the qFlipper application
- [Reading RAW signals](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/sub-ghz/read-raw.md): Reading and sending procedures and configurations of the Read RAW function
- [NFC](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/nfc.md): NFC module's functionality and hardware
- [Pet dolphin](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/basics/dolphin.md): Meet your digital pet dolphin and learn how to keep it happy and help it grow
- [Reading NFC cards](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/nfc/read.md): Learn how to read and emulate NFC cards and the list of supported NFC cards
- [Blueprints of Flipper Zero](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/development/hardware/flipper-blueprints.md)
- [Firmware update](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/basics/firmware-update.md): Learn how to update your Flipper Zero firmware via the Flipper Mobile App and qFlipper
- [Adding new NFC cards](https://docs.flipper.net/zero/nfc/add-manually.md): Learn how to add new virtual NFC cards to your Flipper Zero and explore available card types
